stage_policy: For each exact path, verify a regular existing file against its expected SHA256. Keep identical files. Create a missing exact file new-only and verify it afterward. Reject a divergent existing file; never overwrite it. Do not execute/import programs, touch scientific input/output bytes, or launch work while checking/staging this manifest.
staging_limitation: Unconfirmed means absent from available explicit host receipts, not proven absent remotely. Archive membership alone is not proof of host staging or present integrity.
